capabilities: Chat with an AI assistant about the current note and daily desk
Create and edit markdown notes after approving a plan (never deletes)
Attach markdown, text, or PDF files to chat messages
Dictate text into the open note by voice
Configure tone and instructions in a Jarvis.md file
extras: Marked in the manifest as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Desktop only. README warns not to enable file writes on a vault you would not trust with the voice/chat provider; typed chat goes to Cursor and voice to the chosen Talk provider.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in conversational AI that can discuss the current note and, on approval, write changes directly into the vault.

relations.evidence: uses your Cursor models. A yes writes the vault

summary: AI chat assistant ('Jarvis') that talks to your vault through Cursor account models and can read, create, and edit markdown notes, with optional voice dictation.
